svg.title: Flow past a sphere at increasing Reynolds number
svg.desc: The motion of a sphere to the right is equivalent to fluid flowing to the left past it. (a) At low speed (N′_R less than 1) the flow is laminar and the streamlines close smoothly behind the sphere; viscous drag F_V acts to the left. (b) At higher speed the flow separates from the sphere at the separation points and eddies form behind it; the drag F′_V is larger. (c) At still higher speed the wake is fully turbulent and the drag F″_V is larger still.
